whyEn: Weight-2 chapter supplying the hands-on technique behind two blocks the BC practical grades separately from history: the Vital Signs component (Blood Pressure, Pulse and Respirations each worth 15%/5%/3%; GCS, Skin and Pupils each 5%/3%/1%; SpO2, Blood Glucose and Temperature each 5%/3%/1%) and the Head-to-Toe Physical Examination (Head/Neck, Chest and Lungs, Abdomen, Back, Lower and Upper Extremities each 5%/3%/1%, with the whole block capped at a 15% deduction if any part is skipped). This is the 'how do I actually examine' companion to ch15's 'what do I ask' and ch17's 'what order do the phases go in' — master the four core techniques, the region-by-region head-to-toe survey, and the BC-specific technique requirements flagged in bcAlerts (minimum chest auscultation sites, PCP-vs-EMR scope differences), because those are precisely what an examiner is watching for as your hands move down the patient.
whyZh: 权重 2 星，供应的是 BC 实操考试里两个独立打分板块背后的实际动手技巧：Vital Signs 板块（血压、脉搏、呼吸各占 15%/5%/3%；GCS、皮肤、瞳孔各占 5%/3%/1%；血氧、血糖、体温各占 5%/3%/1%）和 Head-to-Toe 体格检查板块（头颈、胸肺、腹部、背部、上下肢各占 5%/3%/1%，整个板块封顶扣 15%——只要有区域漏做）。这一章是 ch15『问什么』、ch17『评估阶段先后顺序』之外的『到底怎么动手查』——吃透四大检查手法、逐区域的 head-to-toe 检查顺序，以及 bcAlerts 里标出的 BC 专属技术要求（胸部听诊最少听诊点数、PCP 与 EMR 的范围差异），因为这些正是考官盯着你双手往下查体时在看的东西。

sections.titleEn: Overview & the Four Core Examination Techniques
sections.titleZh: 体检总览与四大检查手法

points.en: Physical exam supplies objective, fact-based findings that get cross-checked against the subjective history the patient reports; together the two form a comprehensive assessment. It has two components — vital signs (overall body function) and a sequential head-to-toe survey of organ systems — and in the field it is often condensed into a rapid trauma or medical assessment for an unresponsive patient or one with a significant mechanism of injury.
points.zh: 体格检查提供的是客观、基于事实的发现，要拿去和患者自述的主观病史相互印证，两者合起来才是完整评估。它包含两部分——反映整体身体机能的生命体征，以及按顺序逐系统检查的从头到脚体检——院前环境里常常要压缩成针对无反应患者或有显著受伤机制患者的快速创伤/内科评估。

points.en: The exam only has value once you know what normal looks like — that recognition comes only from direct hands-on experience, so every patient encounter (not just the dramatic ones) is a chance to build your library of normal presentations before you can reliably flag abnormal ones.
points.zh: 查体只有在你先知道『正常长什么样』之后才有价值——这种辨识力只能靠亲手接触患者积累，所以每一次接诊（不只是戏剧化的重症）都是在给自己攒『正常表现』的数据库，之后才谈得上可靠地揪出异常。

points.en: Four core techniques: inspection (a general look, e.g. overall appearance from the doorway, or a focused look at one area like the chest wall); palpation (touching to detect tenderness, deformity, crepitus, a mass effect, pulse quality, or organ enlargement, typically with the hand and forearm flat on one plane, fingers together on the ulnar surface — the same position used to judge skin temperature); percussion; and auscultation.
points.zh: 四大手法：视诊（整体一望，比如从门口看患者整体状态，或聚焦某处如胸壁）；触诊（用手触摸来发现压痛、畸形、骨擦感、包块效应、脉搏质量或脏器肿大，手和前臂通常保持在同一水平面、手指并拢、用尺侧接触——判断皮温也用这个姿势）；叩诊；听诊。

points.en: Percussion technique: lay your hand lightly on the surface, hyperextend your middle finger and press it firmly against the area to be struck, then tap the middle phalanx of that finger with one or two fingertips of your other hand, applying equal force at every site so the sounds are comparable. Normal lung percusses medium-to-loud, low-pitched and resonant; muscle and bone percuss soft, high-pitched and flat; hollow organs like the intestines percuss loud, high-pitched and tympanic (drum-like).
points.zh: 叩诊手法：一手轻贴体表，中指过伸并稳固按压在要叩的部位上，用另一手一两根指尖敲击这根中指的中节指骨，每个部位用力要一致才能横向比较。正常肺野叩诊音是中到响、低调、共鸣音；肌肉和骨骼叩诊是轻、高调、浊音（实音）；肠道这类空腔脏器叩诊是响、高调、鼓音。

points.en: Done properly, palpation should never cause harm — deep palpation in particular takes practice and the judgment to know when to stop pressing.
points.zh: 手法正确的触诊不该造成任何伤害——尤其是深触诊，需要练出手感和『该收手时就收手』的判断力。

points.en: Stethoscope anatomy matters: the bell (cup-shaped) is placed very lightly on the skin, just enough to seal, and picks up low-pitched sounds like heart tones; the diaphragm (flat) is pressed firmly on the skin and picks up high-pitched sounds — breath sounds, bowel sounds, and normal heart sounds. An acoustic stethoscope does not amplify anything; it simply blocks ambient noise. An electronic stethoscope converts the sound wave to an electronic signal and actually amplifies it.
points.zh: 听诊器的构造要分清：钟形头（cup 状）要极轻地贴在皮肤上、刚好密封即可，用来听低调音（心音）；膜形头（平面）要用力紧贴皮肤，用来听高调音——呼吸音、肠鸣音、以及正常心音。声学听诊器本身不放大声音，只是隔绝环境噪音；电子听诊器则把声波转成电信号，是真的会放大。

points.en: Other exam equipment: the sphygmomanometer pairs an inflatable occluding cuff with a manometer to read arterial pressure; the ophthalmoscope (concave mirror plus battery light, viewed through a monocular eyepiece with a rotating lens disk) mostly needs pupil dilation to be useful, so it is rarely practical prehospital; the otoscope (light plus magnifying lens behind a disposable speculum) should never be advanced blindly when hunting a foreign body, or you risk pushing the object deeper into the canal.
points.zh: 其他检查器材：血压计＝可充气袖带（阻断血流）＋压力表（读动脉压）的组合；眼底镜（凹面镜＋电池光源，透过带旋转镜片盘的单目目镜观察）多数情况下需要先散瞳才好用，院前环境很难派上用场；耳镜（光源＋放大镜头，前端接一次性耳窥器）在找异物时绝不能盲目往深处送，否则可能把异物越推越深。

sections.titleEn: Vital Signs: Technique, Trending and Pitfalls
sections.titleZh: 生命体征评估：技术要点、趋势判读与常见陷阱

points.en: Vital signs comprise pulse (rate, rhythm, quality), respirations (rate, rhythm, quality), blood pressure, temperature and pulse oximetry; end-tidal CO2 (capnography) counts as a vital sign too whenever exhaled-gas monitoring matters, especially in an intubated, ventilated patient. The first set, usually taken during the secondary assessment, is the baseline; later sets taken on reassessment are serial vital signs — comparing serials against the baseline is what lets you call a trend (improving, static or deteriorating).
points.zh: 生命体征包括脉搏（频率/节律/质量）、呼吸（频率/节律/质量）、血压、体温和血氧饱和度；只要呼出气监测有意义（尤其插管上机的患者），呼气末二氧化碳（capnography）也算一项生命体征。次级评估时测的第一套叫基线；之后重评时测的叫系列生命体征——把系列值和基线对比，才谈得上判断趋势（好转、持平还是恶化）。

points.en: Pulse technique: compress an artery against a bony prominence and feel the pressure wave; usable sites are radial, brachial, femoral and carotid, and proximal-versus-distal pulses should always be compared. Formal counting runs 15 seconds then multiplied by 4. In responsive patients, count respirations while you appear to still be checking the pulse — patients who know you're watching their breathing tend to unconsciously alter it. In infants under 1 year, palpate the brachial artery rather than the carotid, since a short, fat neck plus a fast native pulse makes the carotid unreliable to find.
points.zh: 脉搏手法：把动脉压在骨性突起上感受压力波；可用点有桡动脉、肱动脉、股动脉、颈动脉，且要养成对比近端与远端脉搏的习惯。正式计数法是数 15 秒再乘以 4。清醒患者身上，可以假装还在摸脉搏、实际数呼吸——一旦患者意识到你在数他的呼吸，往往会不自觉地改变呼吸方式。1 岁以下婴儿要摸肱动脉而不是颈动脉，因为婴儿脖子又短又肉、脉搏又快，颈动脉很难摸准。

points.en: Avoid measuring blood pressure on a painful or injured extremity, an arm with an arteriovenous shunt or fistula, or the side of a prior mastectomy — any of these can cause pain, yield an inaccurate reading, or injure the arm/shunt/fistula itself.
points.zh: 避免在疼痛或受伤的肢体、有动静脉分流/瘘管的手臂，或做过乳腺切除那一侧测血压——这些部位都可能因此致痛、读数不准，或直接损伤手臂/分流管/瘘管本身。

points.en: Respiration technique: count for 30 seconds then multiply by 2, assessed by watching chest movement (and, as needed, the abdominal wall, neck and face) plus accessory muscle use — rate alone is not enough, effort and quality matter just as much, and this is especially useful in pediatric assessment.
points.zh: 呼吸手法：数 30 秒再乘以 2，通过观察胸廓起伏来评估（必要时结合腹壁、颈部、面部运动）以及辅助肌参与情况——光看频率不够，做功和质量同样重要，这一点在儿科评估中尤其有用。

points.en: Pathologic respiratory pattern decode: apnea/bradypnea/dyspnea are breathing that has stopped, slowed, or become laboured (a very wide differential — allergic reaction, asthma, cardiac arrest, choking, overdose, pulmonary fluid, head injury, stroke and more); ataxic (Biot) respiration is an irregular rate-and-depth pattern with intermittent apnea from raised intracranial pressure; Cheyne-Stokes is a gradual crescendo-decrescendo in rate and depth with intermittent apnea, tied to brainstem injury; Kussmaul respiration is deep, gasping breathing classically seen in diabetic ketoacidosis; tachypnea is excessively rapid, shallow breathing from lung disease or other causes such as anxiety or COPD.
points.zh: 病理性呼吸模式速查：呼吸暂停/呼吸过缓/呼吸困难泛指呼吸停止、变慢或费力（鉴别诊断很广——过敏反应、哮喘、心搏骤停、异物窒息、药物过量、肺部积液、头部外伤、卒中等）；共济失调（Biot）呼吸＝不规则的频率和深度，夹杂间歇性呼吸暂停，源于颅内压升高；潮式（Cheyne-Stokes）呼吸＝频率和深度逐渐增强再逐渐减弱、夹杂呼吸暂停，与脑干损伤相关；Kussmaul 呼吸＝深大喘息样呼吸，糖尿病酮症酸中毒的经典表现；呼吸急促（tachypnea）＝过快过浅的呼吸，见于肺病或焦虑、COPD 等其他病因。

points.en: Blood pressure is systolic pressure (generated while the left ventricle contracts) over diastolic pressure (residual pressure while the ventricle relaxes); diastolic should never reach zero, because arteriolar resistance keeps sustaining it, and it is exactly this residual pressure that perfuses the coronary arteries — so a low diastolic pressure means reduced myocardial perfusion, not just a 'good' low number.
points.zh: 血压＝收缩压（左心室收缩时产生）比舒张压（心室舒张时的残余压力）；舒张压正常情况下不会降到零，因为小动脉阻力持续维持着它，而正是这份残余压力在灌注冠状动脉——所以舒张压低意味着心肌灌注下降，不能简单当成『数字低是好事』。

points.en: Cuff sizing rules: too small or too tight a cuff yields a falsely high reading, too large or too loose a cuff yields a falsely low reading; the cuff should be roughly one-half to two-thirds the length of the upper arm. Anxiety and acute-illness stress commonly elevate blood pressure on their own, so weigh a single reading against the patient's overall trend before calling it truly abnormal.
points.zh: 袖带尺寸规则：太小或绑太紧会读出假性偏高，太大或绑太松会读出假性偏低；袖带宽度大致应为上臂长度的二分之一到三分之二。焦虑和急性发病的应激本身就常常升高血压，所以判断血压是否真的异常前，要结合患者整体趋势看，别只信一次读数。

points.en: Pulse oximetry pitfalls: never treat SpO2 as an absolute indicator of oxygen need. False readings can come from hypotension or a cold patient, carbon monoxide poisoning, abnormal hemoglobin (e.g. sickle cell disease), vascular dyes, patient motion, or incorrect probe placement. The governing rule: look at the patient, not the number — if the patient looks sick but the reading is normal, the patient is sick.
points.zh: 血氧饱和度的陷阱：绝不能把 SpO2 当成需不需要给氧的绝对指标。假性读数可能来自低血压或体表偏冷、一氧化碳中毒、异常血红蛋白（如镰状细胞病）、血管染料、患者移动，或探头放置不当。总原则是——看患者本人，别只看数字：患者看起来病重但读数正常，那就应该按『病重』处理。

points.en: Tympanic temperature accuracy has been questioned, especially in patients with severe infection — if a patient looks sick and feels warm but the tympanic reading is normal, switch to a different thermometer type rather than trusting that single number.
points.zh: 鼓室体温的准确性存疑，尤其在重症感染患者身上——如果患者看起来病重、摸起来发烫，但鼓温读数正常，应该换一种测温方式，而不是死信这一个数字。

sections.titleEn: The General Impression: Sick or Not Sick

points.en: The general impression starts as you approach — the environment and the patient's overall presentation already tell you a great deal before you ask the first question; a developed sense of 'sick or not sick?' based on initial appearance is one of the skills that separates an experienced provider from a novice.
points.zh: 整体印象从你走近患者的那一刻就开始了——环境和患者的整体表现，在你问出第一个问题之前就已经透露了大量信息；能否单凭最初的外观形成『病不病』的直觉，是资深救护员和新手的分水岭之一。

points.en: Distress signs to scan for on approach: altered mental status, anxiousness, laboured breathing, difficulty speaking, diaphoresis, obvious pain, obvious deformity, and guarding or splinting of a painful area — but note that patients in substantial, incapacitating pain sometimes present quiet and still rather than visibly writhing, so absence of dramatic behaviour is not absence of severity.
points.zh: 初步接触要扫的痛苦征象：意识改变、焦虑不安、呼吸费力、说话困难、大汗、明显疼痛、明显畸形，以及对痛处的保护性姿势或制动。但要注意：处于剧烈、致残性疼痛中的患者有时反而表现得安静不动，而不是明显挣扎——没有戏剧化表现不等于病情不重。

points.en: Precise vocabulary for describing overall distress matters for handoff: no apparent distress, mild, moderate, acute, and severe describe degree; chronically ill, frail, feeble, robust and vigorous describe general health state — using the right word transmits far more than a vague 'looks okay.'
points.zh: 描述整体痛苦程度的用词要精准，这直接影响交接质量：无明显痛苦、轻度、中度、急性、重度描述的是程度；慢性病容、体弱、虚弱、健壮、精神饱满描述的是整体健康状态——用对词比一句含糊的『看起来还行』传递的信息多得多。

points.en: Skin is often the fastest, most reliable early gauge of overall distress — relatively subtle but serious changes in perfusion typically show up in skin colour, moisture and temperature before other findings become obvious.
points.zh: 皮肤往往是判断整体痛苦程度最快、最可靠的早期指标——灌注上相对细微但严重的变化，通常最先在皮肤的颜色、湿度和温度上显现出来，比其他体征更早暴露问题。

points.en: Pallor reflects poor red-blood-cell perfusion of the skin's capillary beds (also visible in the lips or eye conjunctiva); cyanosis reflects a relative lack of oxygen perfusion regardless of whether red-cell count is adequate, correlates strongly with low arterial oxygen saturation, and shows up most clearly in the nail beds, face and lips.
points.zh: 苍白反映的是皮肤毛细血管床红细胞灌注不足（唇部或眼结膜也能看出来）；发绀反映的是相对氧合灌注不足——不管红细胞数量够不够都可能出现，与动脉血氧饱和度低高度相关，在指甲床、面部和唇部表现得最明显。

points.en: Ecchymosis (localized bruising or blood collection in or under the skin) should prompt a check for underlying soft-tissue, bony or organ injury when it's extensive; serious wounds to the head, neck and torso, along with any evidence of hemorrhage, deserve specific note during this first pass.
points.zh: 瘀斑（皮内或皮下的局部出血/血液聚积）如果范围大，要联想到深层软组织、骨骼或脏器损伤的可能；头颈和躯干的严重伤口，以及任何出血迹象，都应该在这第一轮观察时特别记下来。

sections.titleEn: Mental Status, Skin, Hair and Nails
sections.titleZh: 意识状态与皮肤、毛发、指甲检查

points.en: Minimum mental-status evaluation grades the degree of alertness using Alert-and-Oriented times 4: AOx4 = oriented to person, place, time and event; AOx3 = person, place, time; AOx2 = person and place; AOx1 = person only — each dropped domain lowers the 'times' count by one.
points.zh: 最基本的意识状态评估要用『定向力×4』分级：AOx4＝对人物、地点、时间、事件都定向；AOx3＝人物、地点、时间；AOx2＝人物、地点；AOx1＝只对人物定向——每少一项定向能力，『×』后面的数字就少一。

points.en: AVPU grades to the BEST response elicited, not just the first stimulus you happen to try: A = alert (to person, place and day); V = responds to verbal stimuli; P = responds to painful stimuli (e.g. nail-bed pinch, forearm skin twist); U = unresponsive to either verbal or tactile stimuli. A patient who moans only to a loud shout scores V; one who responds only to a pinch scores P.
points.zh: AVPU 分级要按能引出的『最好反应』来定，不是随便试一个刺激就定级：A＝清醒（对人物、地点、日期均有反应）；V＝对语言刺激有反应；P＝只对疼痛刺激有反应（如掐甲床、拧前臂皮肤）；U＝对语言和触觉刺激都无反应。只对大声呼喊发出呻吟的患者算 V；只对掐痛有反应的算 P。

points.en: Pediatric mental-status pitfalls: even an infant should track your presence with their eyes; ask the caregiver whether the child's alertness is normal for them; most children over 2 years should know their own name plus their parents' and siblings' names; for school-age children, ask about holidays, recent school activities or teachers' names to gauge orientation.
points.zh: 儿科意识评估的坑：连婴儿都应该会用眼睛追踪你的存在；要问照护者『这孩子现在的清醒程度是不是他平时的样子』；2 岁以上的孩子大多应该知道自己的名字，以及父母和兄弟姐妹的名字；学龄儿童可以问节日、最近的学校活动或老师姓名来判断定向力。

points.en: Skin is the body's largest organ with three jobs: thermoregulation (vasoconstriction and pallor in cold, vasodilation, flushing and sweating in heat), relaying environmental sensory information to the brain, and forming an environmental barrier — the outer epidermis is the first line of defence, while the underlying dermis (collagen, elastic fibres, fibroblasts) provides strength and elasticity.
points.zh: 皮肤是人体最大的器官，承担三大功能：体温调节（遇冷血管收缩、肤色变白，遇热血管舒张、潮红出汗）、把环境感觉信息传给大脑，以及构成环境屏障——外层表皮是第一道防线，深层真皮（胶原纤维、弹性纤维、成纤维细胞）负责强度和弹性。

points.en: Skin exam combines inspection and palpation for colour, moisture, temperature, texture, turgor and lesions; the best sites to catch a perfusion change are areas where the epidermis is thinnest — nail beds, lips, conjunctivae, and sometimes palms/soles. Pale skin suggests severe vasoconstriction (anemia, an acute cardiovascular event, shock, or hypothermia); a localized blanched, cool, white patch is typical of frostbite; cyanosis can also reflect hypothermia — not only desaturation — especially in very young patients; mottling signals severe, protracted hypoperfusion or shock and is especially evident in pediatric patients.
points.zh: 皮肤检查要视诊加触诊，看颜色、湿度、温度、质地、弹性和皮损；最容易捕捉到灌注变化的部位是表皮最薄的地方——指甲床、唇部、结膜，有时也看手掌和足底。皮肤苍白提示严重血管收缩（贫血、急性心血管事件、休克或低体温）；局部发白发凉的斑块是典型的冻伤；发绀除了提示血氧下降，也可能是低体温所致——尤其在幼儿身上；花斑提示严重、持续的低灌注或休克，在儿科患者身上尤其明显。

points.en: In older patients, check skin turgor over the upper chest, not the extremities — it is far more reliable there; turgor itself becomes an unreliable dehydration indicator in geriatric patients generally, because of age-related loss of elastin and connective tissue, and the same applies to abnormally dry-feeling skin as a marker in this age group.
points.zh: 老年患者查皮肤弹性（turgor）要选上胸部，不要选四肢——那里更可靠；由于年龄相关的弹性蛋白与结缔组织流失，turgor 在老年群体身上本来就不是可靠的脱水指标，皮肤异常干燥这项体征在这个年龄段同样不太可信。

points.en: Always inspect and palpate the back and any body area hidden by clothing, a backboard, or a head immobilizer — skin lesions can be the only external evidence of a serious internal injury. Multiple bruises at different stages of healing, or pressure sores, are red flags for possible abuse or maltreatment and should be reported.
points.zh: 背部以及被衣物、脊柱固定板或头部固定器遮住的部位，一定要视诊加触诊——皮损有时是严重内部损伤唯一的体表线索。多处不同愈合阶段的瘀伤，或压疮，是可能存在虐待或疏于照护的红旗信号，应当上报。

points.en: Abnormal nail findings map to systemic disease: Beau lines (transverse depressions marking a growth-inhibition episode) point to systemic illness, severe infection or nail injury; clubbing (the nail-to-nail-base angle approaching or exceeding 180°, with fingertip flattening and enlargement) points to chronic respiratory disease; pitting, discolouration and subungual thickening point to psoriasis (an autoimmune disease); splinter hemorrhages (red or brown linear streaks in the nail bed) point to bacterial endocarditis or trichinosis; Terry nails (transverse white bands sparing the distal tip) point to cirrhosis.
points.zh: 指甲的异常表现对应着不同的系统性疾病：Beau 线（横向凹陷，标记着一次生长受抑制）提示系统性疾病、重度感染或指甲外伤；杵状指（甲床与近端甲皱襞夹角接近或超过 180°，指端增宽变厚）提示慢性呼吸系统疾病；点状凹陷、变色加甲下增厚提示银屑病（一种自身免疫病）；甲下线状出血（甲床里红棕色的条纹）提示细菌性心内膜炎或旋毛虫病；Terry 甲（横向白色条带、只留远端一小段本色）提示肝硬化。

sections.titleEn: Head, Eyes, Ears, Nose, Throat and Cervical Spine

points.en: Head anatomy landmarks: occiput (most posterior part of the cranium), temporal regions (lateral sides, where you can feel the superficial temporal artery pulse just anterior to the ear), parietal regions (between temporal and occiput), frontal region (forehead), and the scalp (hair-bearing skin over the fascia covering the skull). Inside the skull, three meningeal layers — the tough outer dura mater, then the thinner arachnoid and pia mater — suspend the brain and cord, with CSF (produced in the third ventricle) filling the space between them as a shock absorber.
points.zh: 头部解剖地标：枕部（颅骨最后方）、颞区（两侧，耳前可摸到颞浅动脉搏动）、顶区（颞区和枕部之间）、额区（前额），以及头皮（覆盖颅骨筋膜、带毛发的皮肤）。颅骨内有三层脑膜——外层坚韧的硬脑膜，以及更薄的蛛网膜和软脑膜——悬吊着脑和脊髓，脑脊液（在第三脑室生成）填充其间，起缓冲垫的作用。

points.en: Head exam = inspect and palpate for deformity, step-off or tenderness; if you find external bleeding, manually part the hair and irrigate the clot to locate the actual source. In infants under 18 months, routinely palpate the anterior fontanelle: open-and-flat is normal; bulging is pathologic in a quiet child (raised intracranial pressure) though it is expected while crying; sunken indicates severe dehydration.
points.zh: 头部检查＝视诊加触诊找畸形、台阶感或压痛；如果发现外出血，要用手把头发分开、冲洗掉血凝块，才能找到真正的出血源。18 个月以下的婴儿要常规触诊前囟：平坦开放是正常；安静状态下膨隆提示病理性（颅内压升高），哭闹时膨隆则是正常反应；凹陷提示严重脱水。

points.en: Face exam covers colour and moisture of the skin, expression, symmetry, contour, any swelling or injury, and signs of respiratory distress; DCAP-BTLS (Deformities, Contusions, Abrasions, Punctures/penetrations, Burns, Tenderness, Lacerations, Swelling) is a useful organizing checklist during palpation, but careful technique and attention still matter more than running through the letters.
points.zh: 面部检查要看皮肤颜色与湿度、表情、对称性、轮廓，以及有无肿胀、损伤或呼吸窘迫迹象；DCAP-BTLS（畸形、挫伤、擦伤、穿刺/贯通伤、烧伤、压痛、裂伤、肿胀）是触诊时好用的清单式记忆工具，但真正起作用的还是仔细的手法和专注，不是照着字母背一遍。

points.en: Eye exam proceeds front-to-back in fixed order, outer structures first: ask about pain/redness, vision loss, diplopia, photophobia, blurring, discharge and corrective-lens use; check visual acuity per eye (with correction in place if normally worn). A Snellen chart isn't practical prehospital — instead use light/dark discrimination or finger counting at set distances (2 m, 1 m, 30 cm), and always state which distance you used when you report the finding.
points.zh: 眼部检查按固定顺序从前往后、先看外层结构：问有无疼痛/发红、视力丧失、复视、畏光、视物模糊、分泌物、是否戴矫正镜；分别测两眼视力（平时戴镜的要戴着测）。院前不适合用 Snellen 视力表，改用明暗辨别或数手指法（固定在 2 米、1 米、30 厘米三个距离），报告时一定要说清用的是哪个距离。

points.en: Pupil check: size (in millimetres), shape and symmetry, plus light reactivity in as dark an environment as possible — shining light into one eye should make BOTH pupils constrict equally (the consensual response). Anisocoria (unequal pupils) can be a normal finding in roughly 20% of the population, so it must always be correlated with the patient's overall presentation before being treated as pathologic. When checking extraocular movement, the eyes should track a finger through a Z or H pattern smoothly and symmetrically — failure to follow in one direction points to weakness of that muscle or dysfunction of its cranial nerve.
points.zh: 瞳孔检查：查大小（毫米）、形状和对称性，并在尽量暗的环境下测光反应——照一只眼睛，双侧瞳孔应该同时等大收缩（互感反应）。瞳孔不等大（anisocoria）在约 20% 的人群里可以是正常表现，所以必须结合患者整体表现来判断，不能一见不等大就直接当成病理征象。测眼外肌运动时，双眼应能平滑对称地随手指走出 Z 形或 H 形轨迹——某个方向追不上，提示相应眼外肌无力或支配它的颅神经功能障碍。

points.en: Penlight exam sequence: lids, lashes and tear ducts (foreign bodies, wounds, discharge) → evert the lids to check for foreign bodies → conjunctivae (should be pink, not cyanotic, pale or overly red) and sclera (should be white, not jaundiced or injected — note that a painless subconjunctival hemorrhage is common and benign) → anterior chamber and iris for clarity, cloudiness or bleeding → posterior chamber and retina, which needs pupil dilation and an ophthalmoscope held 25–50 cm away at a 45° angle to catch the 'red reflex' (cataracts appear as opaque black areas against that reflex).
points.zh: 手电检查顺序：眼睑、睫毛、泪管（找异物、伤口、分泌物）→ 翻开眼睑找异物 → 结膜（应为粉红色，不该发绀、苍白或过红）与巩膜（应为白色，不该黄染或充血——注意无痛性结膜下出血很常见且属良性）→ 前房与虹膜看是否清澈、有无浑浊或出血 → 后房与视网膜，这一步需要散瞳并用眼底镜、在距眼 25–50 厘米处以 45° 角观察『红反射』（白内障在红反射的映衬下呈不透明的黑色区域）。

points.en: Ear anatomy: outer (pinna/auricle plus the external auditory canal leading to the eardrum) → middle (malleus, incus and stapes vibrate with sound, connected to the nasal cavity via the eustachian tube for pressure equalization) → inner (fluid-filled bony chambers whose nerve endings sense head position and movement for balance). Exam checks new hearing changes plus wounds, swelling or drainage (pus, blood, CSF); palpate the mastoid process just posterior to the auricle for discolouration or tenderness (Battle sign). Frank blood or clear watery drainage from the ear or nose after trauma suggests a basilar skull fracture.
points.zh: 耳部解剖：外耳（耳廓＋外耳道，通向鼓膜）→ 中耳（锤骨、砧骨、镫骨随声波振动，经咽鼓管与鼻腔相通以平衡压力）→ 内耳（充满液体的骨性腔室，其中的神经末梢感知头部位置与运动，负责平衡）。检查要问有无新发听力变化，并查伤口、肿胀或渗液（脓、血、脑脊液）；触诊耳廓正后方的乳突，看有无变色或压痛（Battle 征）。外伤后耳或鼻流出鲜血或清亮水样液，提示颅底骨折。

points.en: Nose anatomy: paired chambers divided by the cartilaginous septum, each lined with highly vascular turbinates that humidify inhaled air (and bleed profusely if damaged). Exam checks symmetry, deformity, wounds, foreign bodies, discharge, bleeding and tenderness, plus nostril flaring as a respiratory-distress sign and septal deviation from midline; small mucosal discharge is normal, but a large volume of mucus or any blood/CSF is a serious finding.
points.zh: 鼻部解剖：由软骨鼻中隔分隔成两个腔，各腔内衬血供丰富的鼻甲，负责湿润吸入空气（受损时会大出血）。检查要看对称性、畸形、伤口、异物、分泌物、出血和压痛，以及鼻翼扇动（呼吸窘迫征象）和鼻中隔是否偏离中线；少量黏液分泌属正常，但大量黏液或任何血液/脑脊液都是严重发现。

points.en: Mouth and throat exam: lips should be pink, edema-free and symmetric; gums pink and lesion-free; tongue midline, moist but not swollen; oropharynx checked for discolouration or pustules suggesting infection; note any unusual breath odour (a diagnostic clue); uvula checked for edema and redness. In markedly altered mental status, rapidly determine upper airway status and be ready to manually clear or suction the pharynx.
points.zh: 口咽检查：嘴唇应为粉红色、无水肿、对称；牙龈粉红、无病损；舌居中，湿润但不肿；口咽部要查有无变色或脓疱提示感染；注意异常口气（有诊断提示价值）；悬雍垂查有无水肿和发红。若患者意识明显改变，要快速判断上气道状况，并随时准备手法或吸引清理咽部。

points.en: Neck exam landmarks: jaw, cricothyroid membrane, external jugular veins, thyroid cartilage, suprasternal notch and cervical spinous processes. Check symmetry, masses and jugular venous distention — record how far up the neck (from base to jaw angle) the distention tracks, and note the patient's incline angle relative to flat (0°) when you measured it. Gently palpate the carotid pulses (heavy pressure can trigger a vagal response) and the suprasternal notch for tracheal deviation; assess the temporomandibular joint while the patient opens and closes the jaw; assess lymph nodes for swelling.
points.zh: 颈部检查地标：下颌、环甲膜、颈外静脉、甲状软骨、胸骨上切迹、颈椎棘突。查对称性、包块和颈静脉怒张——记录怒张向上延伸到颈部哪个高度（从颈根部到下颌角之间），并记下测量时患者相对于水平面（0°）的倾斜角度。轻柔触诊颈动脉搏动（用力过大可能诱发迷走反射）以及胸骨上切迹判断有无气管偏移；患者张闭口时评估颞下颌关节；触诊淋巴结查有无肿大。

points.en: Cervical spine assessment weighs mechanism plus pain first, then whether altered mental status or a loss of consciousness occurred at the time, a significant MOI or multiple/distracting injuries, and any intoxicating substance use. Midline posterior tenderness over the spinous processes is always concerning; lateral neck tenderness usually signals a muscular or ligamentous problem rather than the bony column itself. Any pain, tenderness or tingling elicited during range-of-motion testing (rotate shoulder-to-shoulder, then extend, then flex chin-to-chest — passively first, then actively) should stop the exam immediately and move straight to a properly sized collar; a distracting injury elsewhere can mask neck pain, so stay cautious even with an apparently clean neck exam in that setting.
points.zh: 颈椎评估先看受伤机制加疼痛，再看当时有无意识改变或意识丧失、有无显著 MOI 或多发/分散注意力的损伤，以及有无中毒物质影响。棘突正中后方压痛永远值得警惕；颈部两侧压痛通常提示肌肉或韧带问题，而不是骨性脊柱本身。活动度检查（先被动后主动：左右转头、后仰、再前屈下巴触胸）中一旦诱发疼痛、压痛或麻刺感，应立即停止检查、直接换上合尺寸颈托；存在分散注意力的其他损伤时，颈部检查即便『查着没事』也要保持警惕，因为疼痛可能被掩盖了。

sections.titleZh: 胸肺与心血管系统检查

points.en: Chest exam runs three phases in order — chest wall, then pulmonary, then cardiovascular — using inspection, palpation, percussion and auscultation on an exposed chest; posterior technique mirrors the anterior exam.
points.zh: 胸部检查按固定三段顺序进行——先胸壁、再肺部、最后心血管——在暴露胸壁的前提下依次视触叩听；后胸的检查手法和前胸相同。

points.en: Inspection: compare left/right symmetry; note chest shape (can hint at underlying disease, e.g. barrel chest with COPD); look for surgical scars (a pacer pocket, or a midline 'zipper' scar from prior cardiac surgery); note respiratory rate, depth, rhythm and effort, watching for paradoxical movement, accessory-muscle use, or diminished excursion, plus retractions at four sites — suprasternal, sternal, intercostal, subcostal — which matter especially in children. Flag deformities such as barrel chest (COPD), a flail segment or subcutaneous air (trauma), and kyphoscoliosis (compression fractures, COPD).
points.zh: 视诊：对比左右对称性；留意胸廓形状（可能提示基础疾病，如桶状胸提示 COPD）；找手术疤痕（起搏器囊袋，或提示既往心脏手术的正中『拉链』疤）；记录呼吸的频率、深度、节律与做功，留意反常运动、辅助肌参与或胸廓起伏减弱，以及四个部位的凹陷（胸骨上、胸骨、肋间、肋下）——这在儿童身上尤其重要。留意畸形：桶状胸（COPD）、连枷段或皮下气肿（创伤）、脊柱后侧凸（压缩性骨折、COPD）。

points.en: Palpation checks for tenderness or crepitus, especially anywhere flagged abnormal on inspection, and also gauges respiratory symmetry and expansion. Percussion (often impractical prehospital) distinguishes dullness from hyperresonance versus normal resonance: chronic emphysema hyperinflates the lungs, producing hyperresonance where cardiac dullness is normally expected; a chest full of blood percusses dull/hyporesonant, one full of air percusses hyperresonant.
points.zh: 触诊查压痛或骨擦感，尤其是视诊时已标记异常的区域，同时也能评估呼吸对称性和扩张度。叩诊（院前常常不太现实）可分辨浊音、过清音与正常共鸣音的差别：慢性肺气肿会让肺部过度充气，导致原本该是心浊音区的地方变成过清音；胸腔积血叩诊偏浊/共鸣减弱，充气的胸腔则叩诊过清。

points.en: Lungs have five lobes (right: upper, middle, lower; left: upper, lower plus the lingula); auscultate every lobe both anteriorly and posteriorly, direct to skin (never through clothing, which mutes sound), through one full inhale-exhale cycle per placement, ideally with the patient's mouth open to emphasize the sound. Normal sounds are bronchial, vesicular and bronchovesicular; adventitious/pathologic sounds — wheezes and crackles — indicate consolidation, atelectasis, edema, mucus or hemorrhage; stridor is an upper-airway sound often audible without a stethoscope; a pleural rub reflects lost intrapleural integrity from abnormal fluid between the visceral and parietal pleura, producing pleuritic pain.
points.zh: 肺共五叶（右肺：上、中、下叶；左肺：上、下叶加舌叶）；每叶都要前后各听一遍，直接贴皮肤听（隔着衣服听声音会被闷住），每个位置至少听完一次完整的吸气呼气，最好让患者张口呼吸以放大声音。正常呼吸音是支气管音、肺泡音、支气管肺泡音；附加/病理性音——哮鸣音和湿啰音——提示肺实变、肺不张、水肿、黏液或出血；喘鸣是上气道音，常常不用听诊器也能听见；胸膜摩擦音提示脏层和壁层胸膜间异常积液导致胸膜完整性被打破，会产生胸膜性疼痛。

points.en: Recognizing diminished or absent breath sounds matters more than recognizing added sounds, but you can only hear 'diminished' after building a mental library of normal variation through deliberate listening practice. Normal breathing should be quiet and not obviously visible or audible — if you can see or hear the patient breathe from across the room, something is wrong. Causes of diminished/absent sounds span pneumothorax, hemothorax, pleural effusion, pulmonary edema, atelectasis/consolidation, COPD exacerbation, status asthmaticus, opiate intoxication, pneumonia, bronchitis and altered mental status.
points.zh: 听出呼吸音减弱或消失，比听出附加音更重要，但只有先靠刻意的正常呼吸音听诊练习攒够『正常变化谱』的经验，才能真的听出『减弱』。正常呼吸应该是安静的、不该明显看得见或听得见——如果隔着一段距离就能看到或听到患者的呼吸，说明有问题。呼吸音减弱或消失的原因涵盖气胸、血胸、胸腔积液、肺水肿、肺不张/实变、COPD 急性加重、哮喘持续状态、阿片类中毒、肺炎、支气管炎和意识改变。

points.en: Heart sounds: the normal cycle sounds like 'lub-DUB' — S1 (the 'lub') from AV-valve closure at systole's start, S2 (the louder 'DUB') from semilunar-valve closure. S3, a soft low-pitched sound about a third of the way through diastole, can be a normal variant in young people but is always abnormal in a patient older than 35, typically signalling raised atrial filling pressure from moderate-to-severe heart failure. S4 (a gallop, immediately before S1) is always abnormal, reflecting either reduced left-ventricular compliance or raised atrial pressure.
points.zh: 心音：正常心动周期听起来是『咚-哒』（lub-DUB）——S1（『咚』）来自房室瓣在收缩期开始时关闭，S2（更响的『哒』）来自半月瓣关闭。S3 是舒张期约三分之一处出现的柔和低调音，年轻人身上有时是正常变异，但 35 岁以上一律视为异常，通常提示中重度心衰导致的心房充盈压升高。S4（奔马律，紧接在 S1 之前）永远是异常的，反映左心室顺应性下降或心房压力升高。

points.en: Cardiac palpation locates the point of maximum impulse/apical pulse, and feels for lifts or heaves (a strongly-beating sensation suggesting hypertrophy) and thrills (a humming vibration suggesting an underlying bruit or murmur that needs further workup). Auscultation points map to valve locations: aortic (2nd intercostal space, right sternal border), pulmonic (2nd intercostal space, left sternal border), tricuspid (lower left sternal border), mitral (cardiac apex, near the midclavicular line) — listen for S1, S2, and any extra sounds or murmurs at each.
points.zh: 心脏触诊要定位最强搏动点/心尖搏动，并触摸有无抬举样搏动（强烈的搏动感，提示心肌肥厚）和震颤（嗡嗡样振动，提示存在需要进一步排查的杂音或血管杂音）。听诊点对应瓣膜位置：主动脉瓣（第二肋间隙、胸骨右缘）、肺动脉瓣（第二肋间隙、胸骨左缘）、三尖瓣（胸骨左下缘）、二尖瓣（心尖，近锁骨中线）——每处都要听 S1、S2 以及有无额外音或杂音。

points.en: A murmur is an abnormal whoosh-like sound around a heart valve from turbulent flow, graded 1 (softest) to 6 (loudest) — many are normal physiologic murmurs, others reflect valve pathology depending on the anatomy and severity involved; a bruit is the vascular equivalent, most significant when heard over the carotid arteries.
points.zh: 杂音是心脏瓣膜周围因湍流产生的异常『呼呼』声，分级从 1（最轻）到 6（最响）——很多是正常的生理性杂音，另一些则反映瓣膜病变，具体取决于解剖结构与严重程度。血管杂音（bruit）是血管版的杂音，在颈动脉处听到时意义最大。

points.en: Jugular venous distention (JVD) estimates venous capacitance and right-heart function: venous pressure near the vena cava-right atrium junction is normally close to zero, but right-heart failure raises venous capacitance and produces visible JVD on the anterolateral neck (also provokable in a normal person lying supine with legs elevated) — record how many centimetres of distention above the neck base, and the patient's incline angle from flat (0°) when measured. Absent JVD doesn't rule out hypotension, and in chest trauma, JVD plus hypotension can point to tension pneumothorax or pericardial tamponade rather than a simple cardiogenic cause.
points.zh: 颈静脉怒张（JVD）用来估计静脉容量和右心功能：正常情况下腔静脉汇入右心房处的压力接近零，但右心衰会提高静脉容量、在颈部前外侧产生可见的 JVD（也可以在正常人平卧抬腿时诱发出来）——要记录怒张超出颈根部多少厘米，以及测量时患者相对水平面（0°）的倾斜角度。没有 JVD 不能排除低血压；胸部创伤时 JVD 合并低血压，更该想到张力性气胸或心包填塞，而不只是单纯的心源性原因。

points.en: Aging blunts vascular compensation: older patients' vessels constrict and dilate less efficiently (worsened by atherosclerosis, diabetes and many blood-pressure medications), while children and young adults compensate so well — vasoconstriction plus tachycardia — that they can look deceptively less sick than they actually are.
points.zh: 血管代偿能力会随年龄下降：老年患者血管收缩舒张的效率变差（动脉粥样硬化、糖尿病和许多降压药还会进一步削弱这一能力），而儿童和青壮年的代偿能力（血管收缩＋心动过速）好到反而可能让他们看起来比实际病情要轻——别被『看起来还行』的年轻患者骗了。

sections.titleZh: 腹部与泌尿生殖系统检查

points.en: The abdomen is mapped two ways — four quadrants (LUQ, RUQ, LLQ, RLQ, using the umbilicus as the crossing point) or nine regions — and the exam sequence is always inspect, then auscultate, then percuss, then palpate, since touching can alter bowel sounds before you've had the chance to hear them.
points.zh: 腹部有两种分区方式——四象限（左上、右上、左下、右下，以脐为交叉点）或九区法——检查顺序永远是先视诊，再听诊，再叩诊，最后触诊，因为触摸会改变肠鸣音，得赶在动手之前先听。

points.en: History first: location, quality and severity of the pain, onset timing and duration, what the patient was doing at onset, aggravating or relieving factors, and associated symptoms (nausea, vomiting, fever, bowel/bladder/diet changes). Have the patient point to the worst area with one finger, then palpate that area LAST — start on the side opposite the pain and work systematically toward it.
points.zh: 先问病史：疼痛的部位、性质、严重度，起病时间与持续时长，起病时在做什么，加重或缓解因素，以及伴随症状（恶心、呕吐、发热、排便/排尿/饮食变化）。让患者用一根手指指出最痛的地方，然后把那个区域留到最后再触诊——从疼痛对侧开始，系统性地逐步靠近。

points.en: Inspection covers skin, contour, scars, wounds, striae, dilated veins, bruises, rashes, discolouration, and any distension or masses; distinguish distension from obesity (an obese abdomen tends to be more protuberant than distended, and stays pliable). Ascites — a peritoneal fluid collection usually from liver disease, sometimes malignancy or renal/cardiac insufficiency — can show a visible or palpable fluid wave and shifting dullness on percussion.
points.zh: 视诊要看皮肤、轮廓、疤痕、伤口、妊娠纹、静脉怒张、瘀斑、皮疹、变色，以及有无膨隆或包块；要把腹胀和肥胖区分开（肥胖的腹部偏向外凸而不是真正膨隆，且摸起来仍然柔软）。腹水（腹膜腔积液，多见于肝病，也可见于恶性肿瘤或肾/心功能不全）可以看到或摸到液波震颤，叩诊会有移动性浊音。

points.en: Bowel-sound findings: note presence or absence, and character. Hyperactive sounds are loud, high-pitched, rushing or tinkling — raised motility, or classically an obstruction; hypoactive or absent sounds commonly follow recent abdominal surgery or signal peritoneal inflammation.
points.zh: 肠鸣音的发现要记：有无，以及音质。亢进音是响亮、高调、急促或叮当样的——提示动力增强，或典型的肠梗阻；减弱或消失的肠鸣音常见于近期腹部手术后，或提示腹膜炎症。

points.en: Palpation findings and meaning: tenderness (elicited pain) is the single most diagnostically useful finding on abdominal exam. Guarding — voluntary or involuntary muscle contraction — signals peritoneal irritation from an inflamed organ or a ruptured hollow organ spilling its contents; solid-organ bleeding in trauma doesn't always cause guarding unless the bleed is large enough to distend the peritoneum. Marked guarding becomes rigidity, often needing urgent surgery, and is seen with trauma, appendicitis, cholecystitis, hollow-organ perforation, pancreatitis and diverticulitis. Pain that worsens on release of pressure (rebound tenderness) is a reliable sign of peritoneal inflammation, classically appendicitis.
points.zh: 触诊发现及其含义：压痛（能诱发出的疼痛）是腹部检查里诊断价值最高的单一发现。防卫（自主或不自主的肌肉收缩）提示腹膜受到刺激，可能来自脏器炎症或空腔脏器破裂内容物外溢；创伤中实质脏器出血不一定会引起防卫，除非出血量大到让腹膜受牵张。明显的防卫会发展成板状腹（rigidity），往往需要紧急手术，见于创伤、阑尾炎、胆囊炎、空腔脏器穿孔、胰腺炎、憩室炎。松手时痛感加重（反跳痛）是腹膜炎症的可靠体征，典型见于阑尾炎。

points.en: Behavioural pain clues, visible even before you touch the abdomen: restless, constant repositioning fits colicky pain (gastroenteritis, bowel obstruction); absolute stillness resisting any movement fits peritonitis; knees flexed, facial grimacing and rapid or uneven respirations are general pain signals worth noting on inspection alone.
points.zh: 行为性疼痛线索，甚至在你动手之前就能观察到：烦躁不安、不停变换体位提示绞痛（胃肠炎、肠梗阻）；绝对静止、抗拒任何移动提示腹膜炎；屈膝、面部痛苦表情、呼吸急促不匀，这些光靠视诊就值得记下来的一般性疼痛信号。

points.en: Two vascular/structural red flags: a markedly dilated, pulsating upper-midline mass suggests aortic aneurysm — palpation can estimate its diameter, but minimize manipulation once suspected, since the aorta is retroperitoneal and a normal anterior exam does not rule it out; a hernia is a localized abdominal-wall weakness that can strangulate the underlying bowel.
points.zh: 两个血管/结构性红旗：上腹正中一个明显搏动的膨隆包块提示腹主动脉瘤——触诊可以估计其直径，但一旦怀疑就要尽量减少触碰，因为主动脉位于腹膜后，前腹部检查正常并不能排除它；疝是腹壁局部薄弱区，可能压迫甚至绞窄其下的肠管。

points.en: Female genitalia exam is deliberately limited: keep the patient draped, have a female paramedic assist a male examiner when possible, and only examine specifically for concern over life-threatening hemorrhage or imminent delivery — if warranted, limit it to inspection. Palpate the bilateral inguinal and hypogastric regions as part of the abdominal exam regardless. Diffuse lower-abdominal pain in a reproductive-age woman should raise ectopic pregnancy, third-trimester complications, or ovarian/pelvic pathology.
points.zh: 女性生殖器检查要刻意从简：保持患者遮盖，条件允许时让女性救护员协助男性检查者，且只在担心危及生命的出血或临产时才专门去查——真要查，也只做视诊。腹部检查时无论如何都要触诊双侧腹股沟和下腹部区域。育龄女性弥漫性下腹痛，要想到宫外孕、孕晚期并发症，或卵巢/盆腔病变。

points.en: Male genitalia and anal exam are similarly limited, always done with a partner present and the patient draped; testicular torsion or an inguinal hernia can present as lower abdominal pain with minimal abdominal tenderness on exam, so a normal-feeling abdomen doesn't exclude a genital source. In suspected sexual assault, preserve clothing as evidence per local protocol — never delay care to do so, and stay maximally supportive and nonjudgmental throughout.
points.zh: 男性生殖器和肛门检查同样要从简，全程要有搭档在场、患者遮盖到位；睾丸扭转或腹股沟疝可能表现为下腹痛而腹部触诊压痛很轻，所以腹部摸起来正常并不能排除生殖器来源的问题。怀疑性侵个案时，按当地规程保存衣物作为证据——但绝不能为此延误救治，全程要保持最大程度的支持和不带评判的态度。

sections.titleEn: Musculoskeletal, Spine and Peripheral Vascular Exam
sections.titleZh: 肌肉骨骼、脊柱与外周血管检查

points.en: Two fracture categories with very different implications: a physiologic fracture is abnormal force applied to normal bone (typical of high-energy trauma); a pathologic fracture is normal force applied to abnormal, weakened bone (osteopenia, occult malignancy) — same end result, very different underlying process and index of suspicion. Point tenderness is the single most reliable sign of an underlying closed fracture.
points.zh: 两类骨折的临床含义完全不同：生理性骨折＝异常外力作用在正常骨骼上（典型见于高能量创伤）；病理性骨折＝正常外力作用在异常、脆弱的骨骼上（骨量减少、隐匿性恶性肿瘤）——结果看起来一样，但背后的机制和该有的怀疑指数完全不同。压痛点是判断闭合性骨折存在与否最可靠的单一体征。

points.en: Systematic joint/extremity exam checks both structure and function: does it look normal, does it move easily, is there limited range of motion, pain with motion, bony crepitus, swelling, tenderness, heat, redness, ecchymosis, deformity, reduced strength, atrophy, or side-to-side asymmetry. The exam itself should never cause pain — any pain elicited is itself an abnormal finding — and range-of-motion testing always comes last, stopping immediately if the patient reports pain.
points.zh: 关节/肢体的系统检查要同时看结构和功能：外观正常吗？活动顺畅吗？有没有活动受限、活动时疼痛、骨擦感、肿胀、压痛、发热、发红、瘀斑、畸形、力量下降、肌肉萎缩，或左右不对称。检查本身不该造成疼痛——一旦诱发疼痛，这本身就是异常发现——而活动度检查永远放在最后做，患者一喊疼就立刻停。

points.en: Shoulder: a dislocated glenohumeral joint often shows abnormal squaring of the shoulder with the humeral head visible or palpable anteriorly — compare both shoulders from behind the patient (the dislocated side typically sits lower). Palpate the sternoclavicular joint, AC joint, subacromial area and bicipital groove; range with arms overhead, then hands-behind-neck (external rotation/abduction), then hands-behind-lower-back (internal rotation).
points.zh: 肩部：盂肱关节脱位常表现为肩部方肩畸形、肱骨头在前方可见或可触及——从患者背后同时对比双肩（脱位侧通常更低）。触诊胸锁关节、肩锁关节、肩峰下区域和肱二头肌沟；活动度检查依次为双臂上举过头、双手放脑后（外旋/外展）、双手放下背部（内旋）。

points.en: Elbow: inspect for gross deformity or rotation first; palpate between and over the epicondyles/olecranon; range-of-motion testing comes LAST because a suspected elbow fracture needs immobilization before you range it. Heberden and Bouchard nodes (hard, nontender finger-joint nodules) indicate osteoarthritis, not an acute injury.
points.zh: 肘部：先视诊有无明显畸形或旋转；触诊两侧髁上区域和鹰嘴；活动度检查放到最后做，因为怀疑肘部骨折要先固定再考虑活动。Heberden 结节和 Bouchard 结节（硬而不痛的指关节结节）提示骨关节炎，不是急性损伤。

points.en: Hand/wrist: inspect for swelling, redness, contusions, wounds, nodules, deformity or atrophy; palpate each interphalangeal joint medially and laterally, squeeze across the metacarpophalangeal joints, palpate the carpal bones; check capillary refill, radial pulse symmetry and limb temperature as part of the same exam pass.
points.zh: 手/腕：视诊有无肿胀、发红、挫伤、伤口、结节、畸形或萎缩；触诊每个指间关节的内外两侧，挤压掌指关节，触诊腕部各腕骨；同一轮检查里顺带查毛细血管再充盈时间、桡动脉双侧对称性和肢体温度。

points.en: Lower extremity: inspect alignment, deformity, shortening or rotation (suggests proximal injury); palpate for thickening, swelling, bruising, crepitus, tenderness; range the hips (rotation/abduction) and knees (flex the bent knee toward the chest); palpate the hip distal to the inguinal crease and its anterior/lateral/posterior aspects, then palpate and compress the pelvis. Ankle/foot: inspect all surfaces, palpate for tenderness, bogginess, swelling, crepitus, check dorsalis pedis plus posterior tibial pulses, capillary refill, limb temperature, and range (plantarflex, dorsiflex, invert, evert).
points.zh: 下肢：视诊对线、畸形、短缩或旋转（提示近端损伤）；触诊增厚、肿胀、瘀伤、骨擦感、压痛；活动髋关节（旋转/外展）和膝关节（屈膝抱向胸口）；触诊腹股沟褶皱远端的髋部及其前、外、后侧，再触诊并按压骨盆。踝/足：视诊各面，触诊压痛、松软感、肿胀、骨擦感，查足背动脉与胫后动脉、毛细血管再充盈、肢体温度，测活动度（跖屈、背屈、内翻、外翻）。

points.en: Peripheral vascular exam, upper limb: inspect size, symmetry, venous pattern, skin colour/texture, nail-bed colour; palpate and compare radial pulses side to side, moving proximally to the brachial if a pulse is unilaterally absent; palpate epitrochlear and axillary nodes for size, tenderness, redness and mobility if indicated. The five Ps of acute arterial insufficiency — Pain, Pallor, Paresthesia/paresis, Poikilothermia (inability to hold core temperature independent of ambient temperature), Pulselessness — list pulselessness last on purpose: it is the LATEST sign to appear, not the earliest.
points.zh: 外周血管检查，上肢：视诊大小、对称性、静脉纹路、皮肤颜色/质地、甲床颜色；触诊并双侧对比桡动脉，若某侧摸不到就往近端摸肱动脉；必要时触诊肱骨内上髁淋巴结和腋窝淋巴结，查大小、压痛、发红和活动度。急性动脉功能不全的『五 P』——疼痛（Pain）、苍白（Pallor）、感觉异常/轻瘫（Paresthesia/paresis）、体温调节异常（Poikilothermia，无法独立于环境温度维持核心体温）、无脉（Pulselessness）——无脉排在最后是故意的：它是最晚才出现的体征，不是最先出现的。

points.en: Peripheral vascular exam, lower limb: patient supine, socks/shoes off, compare both legs from groin/buttocks to feet for size, symmetry, swelling, venous pattern, skin colour/texture (rubor, ecchymosis or pallor all suggest vascular insufficiency); palpate dorsalis pedis, posterior tibial, femoral (and sometimes popliteal) pulses; check temperature. Pitting edema is graded on a four-point scale by pressing the thumb over the dorsum of the foot or the anterior tibia for at least 5 seconds: +1 = 0–7.5 mm, +2 = 7.5–15 mm, +3 = 15–30 mm, +4 = greater than 30 mm. Bilateral dependent pitting edema suggests a systemic cause (heart failure, cirrhosis); unilateral edema suggests a local cause such as deep-vein occlusion.
points.zh: 外周血管检查，下肢：患者平卧，脱去袜子鞋子，从腹股沟/臀部到足部双侧对比大小、对称性、肿胀、静脉纹路、皮肤颜色/质地（发红、瘀斑或苍白都提示血管功能不全）；触诊足背动脉、胫后动脉、股动脉（有时也能摸到腘动脉）；查温度。凹陷性水肿用四级评分法：用拇指按压足背或胫骨前方至少 5 秒——+1＝0–7.5 毫米，+2＝7.5–15 毫米，+3＝15–30 毫米，+4＝大于 30 毫米。双侧下垂性凹陷水肿提示系统性病因（心衰、肝硬化）；单侧水肿提示局部病因，如深静脉阻塞。

points.en: The spine has 33 vertebrae total, the lowest 9 fused (forming the sacrum and coccyx); its normal curves are cervical, thoracic and lumbar. Lordosis is an exaggerated inward lumbar curve (swayback); kyphosis is an exaggerated outward thoracic curve (common with age, osteoporosis and compression fractures, and can itself become a restrictive-lung-disease source); scoliosis is a sideways curvature and is always abnormal. Comparing shoulder heights and iliac-crest heights is a quick asymmetry screen.
points.zh: 脊柱共 33 节椎骨，最下面 9 节融合（构成骶骨和尾骨）；正常生理曲度为颈、胸、腰三段。腰椎前凸过度（lordosis）＝腰前凸增大（探囊背）；胸椎后凸过度（kyphosis）＝胸段外凸增大（常见于年龄增长、骨质疏松和压缩性骨折，本身还可能造成限制性肺病）；脊柱侧凸（scoliosis）＝侧方弯曲，永远属于异常。快速筛查不对称可以对比双肩高度和双侧髂嵴高度。

points.en: Spine palpation typically happens while log-rolling the patient: thumb-walk each spinous process for tenderness, step-off or crepitus, and also tap the costovertebral angles and palpate the scapulae, paraspinal areas, base of the neck and buttocks. Range-of-motion testing is passive first, then active, stopping immediately at any pain or extremity tingling — keep cervical range conservative and limited, while the rest of the spine (flexion/extension, lateral bending, rotation) can be ranged more freely once trauma has been excluded.
points.zh: 脊柱触诊通常在患者被翻身（log roll）时进行：用拇指逐一触诊每个棘突查压痛、台阶感或骨擦感，同时叩击肋脊角，触诊肩胛骨、脊柱旁区域、颈根部和臀部。活动度检查先被动后主动，一旦诱发疼痛或肢体麻刺感立即停止——颈段活动幅度要保守克制，排除创伤后其余脊柱段（前屈/后伸、侧屈、旋转）可以查得更充分。

points.en: The nervous system splits into CNS (brain plus spinal cord) and PNS (remaining motor and sensory nerves); the brain comprises the cerebrum (conscious processes, four lobes — frontal, temporal, parietal, occipital), the cerebellum (balance and coordination), and the brainstem/medulla (unconscious deep processes). Cranial nerves bypass the spinal cord and run directly to/from the brain via the medulla — except the vagus, which travels down into the chest and abdomen — and there are 12 pairs total, covering a wide range of motor and sensory functions.
points.zh: 神经系统分为中枢神经系统（脑加脊髓）和周围神经系统（其余的运动、感觉神经）；脑由大脑（负责意识活动，分额、颞、顶、枕四叶）、小脑（平衡与协调）和脑干/延髓（无意识的深层活动）构成。颅神经不经过脊髓，而是经延髓直接进出脑部——迷走神经除外，它一路走到胸腹部——共 12 对，覆盖广泛的运动和感觉功能。

points.en: Quick cranial-nerve tests: I olfactory (smell — rarely tested, needs a known scent like ammonia); II optic (vision — finger held in front of the face); III/IV/VI oculomotor/trochlear/abducens (eye, pupil and lid movement together — follow a finger through an H pattern, and blink); V trigeminal (chewing/facial sensation — ask the patient to smile); VII facial (facial movement, tears, taste — same smile test as V); VIII auditory (hearing/balance — follow spoken commands); IX/X glossopharyngeal plus vagus (swallow, taste, pharynx/larynx/thorax/GI sensation and movement — smile then swallow); XI accessory (head/shoulder movement — shrug shoulders against your resistance, comparing symmetry); XII hypoglossal (tongue movement — stick out the tongue). With practice, the entire cranial-nerve exam takes well under 3 minutes.
points.zh: 颅神经速查表：I 嗅神经（嗅觉——很少测，需要氨水一类的已知气味）；II 视神经（视力——手指举在患者面前）；III/IV/VI 动眼/滑车/展神经（眼球、瞳孔、眼睑运动一起测——让患者随手指走 H 形轨迹，并眨眼）；V 三叉神经（咀嚼/面部感觉——让患者微笑）；VII 面神经（面部运动、泪液、味觉——和 V 一样用微笑测试）；VIII 听神经（听觉/平衡——让患者跟着口头指令做）；IX/X 舌咽神经加迷走神经（吞咽、味觉、咽喉/胸腔/消化道感觉与运动——先微笑再吞咽）；XI 副神经（头颈肩运动——让患者耸肩对抗你的阻力，对比两侧对称性）；XII 舌下神经（舌运动——伸舌）。练熟之后，整套颅神经检查能在 3 分钟以内完成。

points.en: The minimum neurologic exam covers baseline mental status (AVPU), cranial nerve function (pupils, eyes, smile, speech, swallow, shoulder shrug), distal motor function, and distal sensory function, adding deep tendon reflexes if indicated.
points.zh: 最基本的神经系统检查要覆盖：基线意识状态（AVPU）、颅神经功能（瞳孔、眼球、微笑、言语、吞咽、耸肩）、远端运动功能、远端感觉功能，必要时再加深腱反射。

points.en: Motor exam: observe posture and body position at rest and with movement; note involuntary movements (quality, rate, rhythm, amplitude) and whether posture, activity, fatigue or emotion seems to drive them; compare major muscle-group bulk and contour side to side; check tone via resistance to passive movement.
points.zh: 运动检查：观察静息和活动时的姿势与体位；记录不自主运动（性质、频率、节律、幅度），判断这些运动是否与姿势、活动、疲劳或情绪有关；对比双侧主要肌群的体积和轮廓；用被动活动阻力来测肌张力。

points.en: Muscle strength is graded 1 to 5 against your resistance: 1 = no contraction or twitch detectable, 2 = active movement only with gravity eliminated, 3 = active movement against gravity, 4 = active movement against some resistance or with evident fatigue, 5 = full resistance without fatigue (normal); report as a ratio, e.g. '4/5 bilateral upper and lower extremities,' testing flexion, extension, grip, abduction, adduction and opposition as the muscle group demands.
points.zh: 肌力对抗你的阻力，分 1 到 5 级：1＝完全无收缩或抽动；2＝只能在消除重力影响下主动活动；3＝能对抗重力主动活动；4＝能对抗一定阻力活动，但有明显疲劳；5＝能对抗充分阻力且不显疲劳（正常）。报告时用比例形式，如『双侧上下肢肌力 4/5』，测试内容按肌群需要涵盖屈、伸、抓握、外展、内收、对掌等动作。

points.en: Coordination exam (heavily cerebellar): rapid alternating movements, point-to-point testing (finger-to-nose, heel-to-shin), stance and gait — gait and stance are tested only if the patient can safely stand; also note any tremor, flap or pronator drift in the upper extremities during this portion.
points.zh: 协调性检查（主要反映小脑功能）：快速轮替动作、点对点测试（指鼻试验、跟膝胫试验）、站姿和步态——只有在患者能安全站立时才测站姿和步态；同时留意上肢有无震颤、扑翼样震颤或旋前肌漂移。

points.en: Sensory exam runs body-to-brain, the opposite direction from motor: compare symmetry side to side and proximal-to-distal. In an extremis patient, sensory testing (shake-and-shout, then more noxious stimuli like a nail-bed pinch or forearm skin twist) is typically the very first check, hunting any sign of preserved higher cerebral function. Routine sensory testing covers gross-versus-light touch (no equipment needed) and, more thoroughly, sharp-versus-dull discrimination and two-point discrimination, reported by dermatome.
points.zh: 感觉检查走的是从躯体到大脑的方向，和运动检查正相反：对比双侧对称性以及近端到远端的差异。对处于危重状态的患者，感觉检查（先摇晃呼喊，再用掐甲床、拧前臂皮肤等更强的刺激）通常是最先做的一步，目的是找有没有残留的高级皮层功能。常规感觉检查包括粗触觉与轻触觉的辨别（不需要器材），更细致的还有锐钝辨别和两点辨别，结果按皮节报告。

points.en: Deep tendon reflexes are graded 0 (no response) to 4+ (hyperactive), with 1+ sluggish, 2+ the expected/active response, and 3+ slightly hyperactive; tested at the biceps (elbow flexed ~45°, strike over the antecubital tendon), brachioradialis (forearm pronated and resting on your arm, strike proximal to the wrist), triceps (elbow flexed 90°), patellar (knee flexed 90°, leg dangling), and Achilles (foot supported in your hand, watch for plantarflexion).
points.zh: 深腱反射从 0（无反应）到 4+（亢进）分级，1+ 是迟钝，2+ 是预期的正常/活跃反应，3+ 是轻度亢进；测试部位包括肱二头肌（肘屈约 45°，敲击肘窝肌腱）、肱桡肌（前臂旋前搭在你手臂上，敲击近腕处）、肱三头肌（肘屈 90°）、髌腱（膝屈 90°，小腿自然下垂）、跟腱（用手托住足部，观察跖屈反应）。

points.en: Primitive reflexes (Babinski, grasping, sucking) are normal in infants, whose long motor pathways aren't yet fully myelinated; the same reflexes appearing in an adult — once those pathways are normally fully myelinated — signal an abnormal disconnection between cerebral cortex and brainstem. The Babinski test itself (stroking the sole with a blunt point, watching for great-toe dorsiflexion with fanning of the other toes) is contraindicated on a patient with lower-extremity injury, since the withdrawal reflex it can trigger risks causing pain and further injury.
points.zh: 原始反射（Babinski 征、抓握反射、吸吮反射）在婴儿身上是正常的，因为长运动传导束还没完全髓鞘化；同样的反射出现在成人身上——此时传导束本该已完全髓鞘化——就提示大脑皮层与脑干之间存在异常断联。Babinski 试验本身（用钝物划足底，观察大拇趾背屈、其余脚趾呈扇形展开）在下肢有损伤的患者身上属于禁忌，因为它诱发的回缩反射可能造成疼痛并加重损伤。

points.en: Interpreting abnormal findings: delirium is an acute, sudden mental-status change from a significant underlying cause; dementia is a gradual, pervasive cognitive decline from slow disease progression — don't conflate the two. Facial and extremity strength asymmetry plus aphasia is the classic stroke (cerebrovascular) pattern. In trauma, a global mental-status change points toward an intracranial mass lesion, while extremity motor loss with a proximal-versus-distal split plus objective paresthesia points more toward a spinal-cord lesion. GCS scores the same eye/verbal/motor domains this section's baseline mental-status check covers, with a more granular, reproducible numeric scale — see the Patient Assessment chapter for the full scoring breakdown.
points.zh: 异常发现的解读：谵妄是急性、突发的意识状态改变，背后有明确的病因；痴呆是缓慢、渐进的认知功能全面衰退，源于慢性病程——两者不要混为一谈。面部与肢体力量不对称加失语，是脑血管病（卒中）的经典组合。创伤情境下，全面性意识状态改变更倾向颅内占位病变；肢体运动丧失呈现近端与远端分离、加上客观的感觉异常，更倾向脊髓损伤。GCS 评估的正是本节讲的意识状态基线检查里那些眼/言语/运动维度，只是用更细致、可重复的数字量表来表达——完整计分细节见『患者评估』章。

sections.titleEn: Pediatric Exam Approach, Recording Findings, and the Limits of the Exam
sections.titleZh: 儿科体检要点、记录与体检的局限

points.en: Pediatric adaptation principle: young children can't reliably self-report, so your exam leans harder on what you can see and hear yourself, cross-checked against family-provided history — obtain parent/guardian permission for the exam whenever the situation allows.
points.zh: 儿科体检的适配原则：年幼患儿无法可靠自述，所以查体要更多依赖你自己能看到、听到的东西，再和家属提供的病史相互印证——情况允许时，先取得家长/监护人对检查的同意。

points.en: Age-tailored strategy: overall, examine children toe-to-head rather than head-to-toe — it builds trust and lowers fear before you get near the face. Infants generally tolerate handling reasonably well, so vital signs and physical findings carry more weight than a limited history. Ages 1–3 are the hardest group (reflexive resistance to a stranger's touch) — stick with toe-to-head, set clear ground rules, and enlist family to help hold and position the child safely. Ages 4–5 and up are usually cooperative enough for the standard head-to-toe approach; school-age children should be actively engaged and told what you're doing as you go; adolescents need extra attention to autonomy and body-image concerns — reassure explicitly when a finding isn't actually concerning.
points.zh: 分年龄的检查策略：总体原则是从脚查到头，而不是从头查到脚——这样能在靠近脸部之前先建立信任、降低恐惧。婴儿通常还算能耐受被摆弄，所以生命体征和体格检查发现比有限的病史更重要。1–3 岁是最难处理的年龄段（对陌生人的触碰会本能抗拒）——坚持从脚到头，先定好检查的『规矩』，并请家属协助安全地固定/摆放孩子。4–5 岁及以上通常配合度足够，可以用标准的从头到脚顺序；学龄儿童应该主动参与检查过程，边查边讲解你在做什么；青少年格外在意自主权和身体完整性，发现没什么问题时要明确安慰他们。

points.en: Universal pediatric principles: stay calm, patient and gentle regardless of how chaotic the scene is; be honest about what will hurt, without drama; keep child and parent together whenever possible, since separation anxiety compounds acute illness or injury fear; never assume a pediatric trauma patient's pain is less real, or treat it less aggressively, than an adult's.
points.zh: 儿科通用原则：不管现场多混乱，都要保持冷静、耐心、温和；如实告诉孩子哪里会痛，但不要渲染；尽量让孩子和家长待在一起，因为分离焦虑会叠加在急性伤病的恐惧之上；绝不能认为儿童创伤患者的疼痛比成人『不那么真实』，处理力度也不该因此打折扣。

points.en: Documentation must be orderly, concise and complete — omitting relevant information undermines both the handoff and the legal medical record; whatever format your medical director specifies, modifications are fine as long as the basic documentation requirements survive. Record objective signs AND pertinent negatives, not just positive findings, in the same order you'd use for a verbal report.
points.zh: 记录必须有条理、简洁、完整——遗漏相关信息既影响交接，也会削弱其作为正式病历的法律效力；用医疗总监规定的格式，可以微调，但基本的记录要求不能省。要记录客观体征和相关阴性发现，不只是阳性发现，顺序和口头交接报告保持一致。

points.en: The legal/ethical spine of the exam: respect patient autonomy in decision-making, stay accountable to the patient, protect confidentiality and privacy, obtain consent, recognize the line into assault and battery, understand and respect advance directives, and document facts accurately without editorializing.
points.zh: 体格检查背后的法律与伦理准则：尊重患者的自主决策权，对患者负责，保护患者的保密与隐私，取得同意，认清哪一步会构成人身侵犯（assault and battery），理解并尊重预立医疗指示，记录事实要准确、不带个人评判。

points.en: The physical exam has real limits — it can surface what a patient can't or won't disclose, but even the most skilled exam can't replace physician evaluation plus lab and imaging studies for a definitive diagnosis. Treat prehospital physical findings as one input toward a working field impression, not a final diagnosis.
points.zh: 体格检查有其真实局限——它能挖出患者说不出口或不愿说的信息，但再高明的查体也代替不了医生评估加化验影像检查才能拿到的确定性诊断。院前的体检发现，只是拼凑现场初步印象的一块拼图，不是最终诊断。

atScene.en: Done properly, palpation should never cause harm — deep palpation especially takes practice and the judgment to know when to stop.
atScene.zh: 手法正确的触诊不该造成任何伤害——尤其是深触诊，需要练出手感和该收手时就收手的判断力。

atScene.en: A patient's age, underlying conditions and current medications can all skew vital signs — treat the numbers as one input and keep your attention on the patient, not the monitor.
atScene.zh: 患者的年龄、基础病和正在用的药物都可能让生命体征偏离常态——把这些数字当成一项参考，注意力始终留在患者身上，不是仪器屏幕上。

atScene.en: Look at your patient, not the number: if the patient looks sick but the pulse oximetry reading is normal, the patient is sick.
atScene.zh: 看患者，别看数字：患者看起来病重但血氧读数正常，那就应该按病重处理。

atScene.en: Frank blood or clear watery drainage from the ears or nose after trauma is a basilar-skull-fracture warning sign, not something to dismiss as a nosebleed or wax.
atScene.zh: 外伤后耳朵或鼻子流出鲜血或清亮水样液，是颅底骨折的警示信号，不能随便当成普通鼻血或耳垢处理。

atScene.en: Never advance an otoscope tip blindly while hunting a foreign body in the ear canal — you risk pushing the object further in.
atScene.zh: 在耳道里找异物时，绝不能盲目把耳镜探头继续往深处送——很可能把异物越推越深。

atScene.en: Chronic emphysema hyperinflates the lungs, so percussion can produce hyperresonance exactly where you'd normally expect cardiac dullness — don't mistake that for a pneumothorax reflexively.
atScene.zh: 慢性肺气肿会让肺部过度充气，叩诊时原本该是心浊音区的地方也可能变成过清音——别一听到过清音就反射性当成气胸。

atScene.en: Point tenderness on palpation is the single most reliable sign of a closed fracture underneath — weight it heavily even without obvious deformity.
atScene.zh: 触诊找到的压痛点，是判断皮下有闭合性骨折最可靠的单一体征——就算没有明显畸形，也要高度重视这个发现。

atScene.en: Log-rolling the patient onto a backboard is always a chance to actually see and feel the back for injury — brief it out loud with your team so no one skips the look.
atScene.zh: 把患者翻上脊柱固定板的那个动作，永远是真正看到、摸到背部损伤的机会——出声跟团队交代清楚，别让任何人漏掉这一眼。

atScene.en: Never perform a Babinski test on a patient with a lower-extremity injury — the withdrawal reflex it can provoke risks causing pain and worsening the injury.
atScene.zh: 下肢有损伤的患者，绝不能做 Babinski 试验——它诱发的回缩反射可能造成疼痛，还会加重损伤。

confusions.en: 'A more thorough exam is always a better exam.' In reality relevance and priority beat sheer volume — a condensed rapid trauma/medical assessment is the correct call for an unresponsive patient or one with a significant MOI, not a corner-cutting shortcut.
confusions.zh: 误区：『查得越细越全就越好』。实际上相关性和优先级比检查量更重要——针对无反应患者或有显著受伤机制的患者，压缩成快速创伤/内科评估才是正确做法，不是偷工减料。

confusions.en: 'A normal pulse oximetry reading means the patient is fine.' In reality false-normal readings are common — hypotension, cold extremities, CO poisoning, abnormal hemoglobin, vascular dyes, motion and bad probe placement can all mask a truly sick patient. Look at the patient, not the number.
confusions.zh: 误区：『血氧读数正常就说明患者没事』。实际上假性正常读数很常见——低血压、肢体冰冷、一氧化碳中毒、异常血红蛋白、血管染料、患者移动、探头放置不当，都可能掩盖一个真正病重的患者。要看患者，不是看数字。

confusions.en: 'Unequal pupils always mean brain injury.' In reality anisocoria is a normal finding in roughly 20% of the population — it must be correlated with the whole clinical picture before being treated as pathologic.
confusions.zh: 误区：『瞳孔不等大就是脑外伤』。实际上瞳孔不等大在约 20% 的人群中是正常表现——必须结合整体临床表现来判断，不能一见不等大就当成病理征象。

confusions.en: 'Poor skin turgor in an older patient proves dehydration.' In reality turgor is an unreliable dehydration indicator in geriatric patients because of age-related loss of elastin and connective tissue — weigh other signs, and test over the upper chest rather than the extremities if you use it at all.
confusions.zh: 误区：『老年人皮肤弹性差就能证明脱水』。实际上由于年龄相关的弹性蛋白和结缔组织流失，turgor 在老年患者身上本来就是不可靠的脱水指标——要综合看其他体征，真要测也该测上胸部而不是四肢。

confusions.en: 'Young children should be examined head-to-toe just like adults, for consistency.' In reality toddlers and preschool-age children do better examined toe-to-head — it builds trust and lowers fear before you get near the face, which is exactly backward from the adult sequence.
confusions.zh: 误区：『小孩也该按大人那套从头到脚查，图个统一』。实际上幼儿和学龄前儿童更适合从脚查到头——这样能在靠近脸部之前先建立信任、降低恐惧，恰好和成人顺序反过来。

confusions.en: 'AVPU's P just means the patient reacted somehow to pain.' In reality you grade to the BEST response elicited across both verbal and painful stimuli — a patient who moans to a shout scores V, not P, even though pain wasn't the trigger that got the response.
confusions.zh: 误区：『AVPU 里的 P 就是对疼痛有点反应就行』。实际上要按语言刺激和疼痛刺激两者中能引出的最好反应来定级——对着大声呼喊发出呻吟的患者算 V，不算 P，即使你后来又试了疼痛刺激。

mnemonics.name: DCAP-BTLS
mnemonics.en: Deformities, Contusions, Abrasions, Punctures/penetrations, Burns, Tenderness, Lacerations, Swelling — an organizing checklist for inspection and palpation of the head, face, chest and other regions.
mnemonics.zh: 畸形、挫伤、擦伤、穿刺/贯通伤、烧伤、压痛、裂伤、肿胀——用于头面部、胸部等区域视诊触诊时的记忆清单。

mnemonics.name: 急性动脉功能不全五 P
mnemonics.en: Pain, Pallor, Paresthesia/paresis, Poikilothermia, Pulselessness — remember pulselessness is deliberately last on the list because it's the LATEST sign to appear, not the earliest.
mnemonics.zh: 疼痛（Pain）、苍白（Pallor）、感觉异常/轻瘫（Paresthesia/paresis）、体温调节异常（Poikilothermia）、无脉（Pulselessness）——无脉排最后是有意的，它是最晚才出现的体征，不是最先出现的。

mnemonics.name: 钟形头 vs 膜形头
mnemonics.en: Bell = low and light — low-pitched sounds, placed lightly on the skin. Diaphragm = high and hard — high-pitched sounds, pressed firmly on the skin.
mnemonics.zh: 钟形头＝低而轻——听低调音，轻轻贴皮肤；膜形头＝高而重——听高调音，用力紧贴皮肤。

mnemonics.name: AVPU
mnemonics.en: Alert, Verbal, Pain, Unresponsive — always grade to the best response elicited across both stimuli, not the first one you happen to try.
mnemonics.zh: 清醒（Alert）、对语言有反应（Verbal）、对疼痛有反应（Pain）、无反应（Unresponsive）——始终按两种刺激中能引出的最好反应定级，不是随便试一个就定。

selfCheck.qEn: A patient is talking normally but the pulse oximeter reads 70%. Which do you trust more — the patient's presentation or the number?
selfCheck.qZh: 患者说话正常，但血氧饱和度只读到 70%，你更该信谁——患者本身的表现，还是这个数字？
selfCheck.aEn: Trust the patient's overall presentation first, per the 'look at the patient, not the number' rule — then work through the common causes of a false pulse oximetry reading (hypotension, cold extremity, CO poisoning, abnormal hemoglobin, vascular dye, motion, bad probe placement) before assuming the patient is truly hypoxic or truly fine.
selfCheck.aZh: 先信患者本人的整体表现，遵循『看患者，别看数字』原则——再逐一排查血氧读数假性异常的常见原因（低血压、肢体冰冷、一氧化碳中毒、异常血红蛋白、血管染料、患者移动、探头放置不当），而不是直接认定患者真的缺氧或真的没事。

selfCheck.qEn: Can loose, slow-rebounding skin turgor alone confirm dehydration in a 78-year-old patient?
selfCheck.qZh: 一名 78 岁老人皮肤松弛、捏起后回弹很慢，光凭这一项就能确诊脱水吗？
selfCheck.aEn: No — turgor is an unreliable dehydration indicator in geriatric patients because of age-related elastin and connective-tissue loss; weigh it alongside other findings, and if you use it at all, test over the upper chest rather than the extremities.
selfCheck.aZh: 不能——由于年龄相关的弹性蛋白与结缔组织流失，turgor 在老年患者身上本来就是不可靠的脱水指标；要综合其他体征判断，真要测也该测上胸部，而不是四肢。

selfCheck.qEn: At what patient age does an S3 heart sound always count as abnormal, and what does it typically signal?
selfCheck.qZh: S3 心音在多大年龄以上的患者身上一律视为异常？通常提示什么？
selfCheck.aEn: Always abnormal in a patient older than 35 years — it typically signals moderate-to-severe heart failure raising atrial filling pressure (though it can be a normal variant in young, healthy people).
selfCheck.aZh: 35 岁以上一律视为异常——通常提示中重度心衰导致的心房充盈压升高（在年轻健康人身上有时可以是正常变异）。

selfCheck.qEn: On the BC practical exam, if a candidate completely misses one region of the Head-to-Toe physical examination, what's the deduction — and what's the cap on the whole block?
selfCheck.qZh: BC 实操考试里，Head-to-Toe 体格检查如果某个区域完全没做，扣多少分？整个板块的扣分封顶是多少？
selfCheck.aEn: A completely missed region is a major deficiency worth 5% (moderate 3%, minor 1%) — but even if several regions are missed, the whole Head-to-Toe block is capped at a maximum 15% deduction.
selfCheck.aZh: 单个区域完全漏做属于严重失误，扣 5%（中度 3%、轻微 1%）——但即便多个区域都漏做，整个 Head-to-Toe 板块的扣分也是封顶的，最多扣 15%。

selfCheck.qEn: What is the deep tendon reflex grading scale, and what does 2+ represent?
selfCheck.qZh: 深腱反射的评分范围是什么？2+ 代表什么？
selfCheck.aEn: 0 to 4+ on a five-point scale: 0 = no response, 1+ = sluggish, 2+ = the expected/active response, 3+ = slightly hyperactive, 4+ = hyperactive.
selfCheck.aZh: 0 到 4+，共五档：0＝无反应，1+＝迟钝，2+＝预期的正常/活跃反应，3+＝轻度亢进，4+＝亢进。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Head-to-Toe physical exam: textbook narrative vs BC's graded, capped deduction structure
bcAlerts.topicZh: Head-to-Toe 体格检查：教材叙述式讲法 vs BC 的量化扣分与封顶结构
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook describes the head-to-toe survey as a sequential, region-by-region exam (head/neck, chest/lungs, abdomen, back, lower extremities, upper extremities) without quantifying how missing a region is scored.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把 head-to-toe 检查描述成一个按区域顺序进行的检查流程（头颈、胸肺、腹部、背部、下肢、上肢），但没有量化漏做某个区域会扣多少分。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's practical grading criteria score each of the six regions independently — 5% major deficiency (failing to examine, or finding-but-not-treating/documenting an injury when present or pertinent), 3% moderate, 1% minor — but critically, the ENTIRE Head-to-Toe block is capped at a maximum 15% deduction even if a candidate misses all or part of the exam across multiple regions. The order the regions are examined in is explicitly irrelevant to grading.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 实操评分标准对六个区域各自独立打分——严重失误（该查未查，或查出损伤/异常却未处置/记录）扣 5%，中度 3%，轻微 1%——但关键是，即便考生在多个区域都漏做，整个 Head-to-Toe 板块的扣分是封顶的，最多扣 15%。检查各区域的先后顺序对评分而言明确无关紧要。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Vital signs: textbook technique-only vs BC's per-parameter deduction weights
bcAlerts.topicZh: 生命体征：教材只讲技术手法 vs BC 按项目量化的扣分权重
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook covers pulse, respiration, blood pressure, temperature and pulse oximetry purely as measurement techniques and trending concepts, without assigning any scoring weight to each parameter.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材讲脉搏、呼吸、血压、体温、血氧只讲测量手法和趋势判读概念，没有给任何一项分配具体的扣分权重。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's Vital Signs component grades Blood Pressure, Pulse and Respirations each at 15% major / 5% moderate / 3% minor (reflecting how central these three are to detecting deterioration); GCS, Skin and Pupils are each graded at 5% major / 3% moderate / 1% minor within the Vital Signs component. A separate Diagnostics component grades Pulse Oximetry, Blood Glucose and Temperature each at 5% major / 3% moderate / 1% minor. Expect these numbers to be tested and remember the asymmetry: BP/Pulse/Resp carry 3x the weight of GCS/Skin/Pupils/SpO2/BGL/Temp.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 的 Vital Signs 板块里，血压、脉搏、呼吸各自严重失误扣 15%（中度 5%、轻微 3%），反映这三项在判断病情恶化上的核心地位；GCS、皮肤、瞳孔在同一板块内各自严重失误扣 5%（中度 3%、轻微 1%）。另有一个独立的 Diagnostics 板块，血氧、血糖、体温各自严重失误扣 5%（中度 3%、轻微 1%）。这几个数字很可能被考到，要记住这个不对称关系：血压/脉搏/呼吸的权重是 GCS/皮肤/瞳孔/血氧/血糖/体温的 3 倍。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Chest auscultation: textbook's general 'each lobe' vs BC's minimum-site count
bcAlerts.topicZh: 胸部听诊：教材泛泛的『每叶都听』 vs BC 规定的最少听诊点数
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook instructs listening over each of the five lung lobes both anteriorly and posteriorly, but gives no minimum number of discrete listening sites.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材只说五个肺叶前后都要听，没有给出具体要听多少个听诊点。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's grading criteria specify a concrete minimum: the candidate should auscultate the chest in at least either 6 anterior or 6 posterior locations, listening through both the inspiratory and expiratory phase at each, and should verbalize air entry, bilateral comparison, and breath sounds findings out loud for the examiner. Falling short of that minimum count, or auscultating through clothing, both risk a deduction under Chest and Lungs in the Head-to-Toe block.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 官方评分标准给出了明确的最低数量：考生应在胸部前面或后面至少选 6 个部位听诊，每个部位都要听完吸气和呼气两个时相，并要向考官口头报告气体进入情况、双侧对比和呼吸音发现。听诊点数不够，或隔着衣服听，都可能在 Head-to-Toe 板块的『胸肺』一项被扣分。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Abdominal auscultation: textbook's universal step vs BC's PCP-only requirement
bcAlerts.topicZh: 腹部听诊：教材当成通用步骤 vs BC 限定 PCP 才要求
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook presents abdominal auscultation for bowel sounds as a routine step in the standard inspect-auscultate-percuss-palpate sequence, applicable to all providers.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把腹部听诊肠鸣音当成『视触叩听』标准顺序里的常规一步，对所有级别的救护员一视同仁。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's grading criteria explicitly note that the EMR candidate is NOT required to auscultate the abdomen — only PCP candidates are graded on it. Skipping abdominal auscultation is scope-appropriate at EMR level and should not cost points there, but is expected at PCP level as part of the Abdomen region of the Head-to-Toe exam.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 评分标准明确写明：EMR 级别的考生不要求听诊腹部——只有 PCP 级别的考生会在这一项上被打分。EMR 级别跳过腹部听诊属于该级别范围内的正常操作，不该被扣分；PCP 级别则要求把它作为 Head-to-Toe 检查『腹部』一项的一部分完成。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Pupil exam: textbook's general technique vs BC's explicit reactivity-plus-size requirement
bcAlerts.topicZh: 瞳孔检查：教材的一般手法 vs BC 明确要求反应性加大小两项都测
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook teaches checking pupil size, shape, symmetry and light reactivity as a single integrated step, without separating out what counts as a scoreable failure.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把瞳孔大小、形状、对称性、光反应当成一整套动作来教，没有区分哪一部分是会被单独扣分的失误。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's Vital Signs grading criteria call out two distinct failure modes for pupils: assessing pupils but not checking BOTH reactivity and size is itself a moderate deficiency (5%), and separately, failing to interpret unequal, unreactive, dilated or constricted pupils correctly is graded as a major deficiency. Pupils must also be reassessed with every set of vital signs when clinically indicated (e.g. a head-injury or decreased-LOC patient) — checking once and never repeating it is itself a deduction.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 的 Vital Signs 评分标准把瞳孔检查拆成两种不同的失误：只检查了瞳孔但没有同时查『反应性』和『大小』两项，本身就算中度失误（扣分）；而未能正确判读瞳孔不等大/无反应/散大/缩小的临床意义，则算严重失误。此外，只要临床有指征（如头外伤或意识水平下降的患者），每一套生命体征都要重新查瞳孔——只查一次不再复查同样会被扣分。
